$comment: What scripts/measure-edit-to-view.cs holds each target to, in milliseconds: the warm median of each
part named, and the run fails over it (#900). A target holds a budget once its number meets the
roadmap's bar of a second. The desktop does. The web does not, by tens of seconds, and the issues
under #898 own each part of it over the bar: its numbers are reported on every run, and it gets a
budget here the day it meets the bar.
